direct_dependency_margin.name: paired_direct_dependency_margin_v1
direct_dependency_margin.panel: the same frozen validation ordinals 0..99 used for fixed-panel NLL
direct_dependency_margin.matched_condition: same-row prerequisite groups visible; active and future groups masked
direct_dependency_margin.counterfactual_condition: same mask and visible positions, but prerequisite token values come from the next deterministic validation donor with the same N
direct_dependency_margin.donor_rule: smallest validation ordinal greater than the target with the same N and a different answer, wrapping once
direct_dependency_margin.pair_nll: unweighted mean token cross entropy on the completely masked active group
direct_dependency_margin.row_margin: mean over non-root groups of counterfactual_nll minus matched_nll
direct_dependency_margin.uncertainty: 10000 deterministic paired row-bootstrap replicates with seed 20260801
direct_dependency_margin.interpretation: likelihood-only dependency diagnostic; not a shuffle training arm and not body completion evidence

loss_decision.reason: B1 and B2 fixed-panel IID validation NLL fell by about 25.6 percent from the common B0 initialization; absolute training loss is a diffusion-weighted estimator and is not comparable to ordinary token CE
